name: Corporate Action 82
definition: An event determined by a corporation's board of directors, that changes the existing corporate capital structure or financial condition.

CorporateActionEventIdentification.name: Corporate Action Event Identification
CorporateActionEventIdentification.definition: Reference assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a corporate action event.

OfficialCorporateActionEventIdentificati.name: Official Corporate Action Event Identification
OfficialCorporateActionEventIdentificati.definition: Official and unique reference assigned by the official central body/entity within each market at the beginning of a corporate action event.
